newsitem.title: USA: Imation Q4 shr $0.28 excluding writeoff.
newsitem.headline: Imation Q4 shr $0.28 excluding writeoff.

text.p: (All data above in millions, except per share numbers)
NOTE - Full company name is Imation Corp.
1996 Q4 excludes $12 million write-off for research and development. Including the write-off, the company lost $0.6 million, or $0.02 per share, in the period.
1995 Q4 exclude pre-tax restructuring and one-time charges of $166.3 million. Including those charges, the company lost $87.5 million, or $2.08 per share, in the period.

Results for the full years 1996 and 1995 exclude restructuring and special charges of $88.4 million vs $166.3 million. Including the charges, the company showed a net loss of $20.5 million, or $0.49 per share, vs loss of $85.0 million, or $2.02 per share.
